weight_adjustment_1000kg.description: Slush/standing water weight adjustment vs dry field/obstacle limit weight, by depth and pressure altitude. Values are additive (negative) adjustments in 1000 KG.

v1_mcg_limit_weight_1000kg.description: V1(MCG) limit weight by adjusted field length, depth, and pressure altitude. null = not published (triangular table; verified against page render).

v1_adjustment_kias.description: V1 speed adjustment (KIAS) by actual weight, depth, and pressure altitude.

procedure_notes: Enter Weight Adjustment table with slush/standing water depth and dry field/obstacle limit weight to obtain slush/standing water weight adjustment.
Adjust field length available for temperature (see field_length_temp_adj_per_5c in this entry) for every 5C above/below 4C.
Find V1(MCG) limit weight for adjusted field length and pressure altitude.
Max allowable slush/standing water limited weight is the lesser of the weight-adjustment result and the V1(MCG) limit weight.
Obtain V1, VR, V2 for the actual weight using the Dry Runway Takeoff Speeds table.

If V1(MCG) limited, set V1 = V1(MCG). If not V1(MCG) limited, enter V1 Adjustment table with the actual weight to obtain V1 speed adjustment. If adjusted V1 is less than V1(MCG), set V1 = V1(MCG). V1 not to exceed VR.

antiskid_inoperative_takeoff.applicability: Dry runway only. Anti-skid inoperative is only allowed on a dry runway.

v1_adjustment.description: Reduce normal dry field/obstacle limited weight by dry_field_obstacle_weight_penalty_kg, then reduce V1 (associated with the reduced weight) by the amount shown, indexed by field length.

antiskid_inoperative_takeoff.notes: If the resulting V1 is less than V1(MCG), takeoff is permitted with V1 set equal to V1(MCG) provided the dry accelerate-stop distance adjusted for wind and slope exceeds approximately 1800 m. A detailed analysis for the specific case from the Airplane Flight Manual may yield a less restrictive penalty.

notes: V1(MCG) limit weight (triangular) tables for both slush/standing-water and slippery-runway variants were cross-checked against rendered page images (not just text extraction) to confirm null/blank-cell placement, since the raw PDF text stream loses column position for cells at the edges of these jagged tables.
